messages:
Samira K: Quick sync  we keep seeing weird healthscore drops after playbook automations run. Suspect CRM tag churn (auto-tags + manual edits) is causing transient 'unknown' segments. Anyone else?

Ethan P: saw similar in logs. Healthscore recompute job runs immediately after playbook updates; if tags change back within minutes, we double-count.

Samira K: example: account 8231 had tag 'onboarded' removed by webhook, then playbook re-added it; net effect was healthscore bounce -0.12.

Priyanka R: AMs report confusing pings when an account toggles between 'onboarded' and 'in_progress' quickly. We should debounce tag changes before recommputing health.

Ethan P: agree. Proposed fix: introduce 5-minute write-debounce window for tag-driven playbook triggers and a reconcile step that collapses rapid flips. Pseudocode:
if tag_change and last_tag_change < now() - interval '5 minutes':
  trigger recompute
else
  queue for debounce worker

Samira K: also want a short-lived 'transient_tag' flag on accounts while in the debounce window so playbooks skip creating tasks for transient states.

Priyanka R: for enablement, we need guidance: AMs should only action tasks created after debounce completes (add note in subject: "(stable)"). I'll update playbook doc.

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-6122: "tag-debounce-reconcile" assigned to Ethan P, due 2025-10-02.

Ethan P: will implement debounce middleware and a reconcile job to collapse repeated toggles in the last 24h. I'll add metrics: number of debounced events, avg debounce delay, and rollback triggers.

Samira K: gate conditions: enable if debounced events reduce noisy tasks by 60% in 48h staging window and no high-ARR accounts are delayed >15 minutes without action.

Priyanka R: will draft AM-facing note and tweak playbook templates to include "(stable)" marker for tasks. Also add a short FAQ for when a task disappears (it was transient).

Ethan P: staging branch up by EOD. I'll post staging run ID here when scheduled.

Samira K: owners: Samira (owner), Ethan (engineer), Priyanka (enablement). Thanks team.
